headline: UK energy bills to surge 26% in January, fixed deals less attractive
summary: Despite some fixed deals being lower than the new cap, many UK consumers find savings insufficient to offset the risk of higher bills in January.
why: Rising energy bills affect household budgets and consumer confidence, influencing retail and energy markets.

impacts.name: UK energy price cap
impacts.why: Price cap increase raises household energy costs.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
